estimate_after_campaign.claim: Micro Φ̂=0.0167 nats over 8 estimator elements covering 8 live channels (2070 samples; certified exhaustive MIP; z=8.6). Selected held-out grain k=4: Φ̂=0.0656, z=20.6, family-wise p=0.010, 90% CI [0.0204, 0.0893]. integration beats chance. payload.regime_note: estimate_after_campaign covers BOTH the decision-workload regime and the post-campaign rest/recovery regime (360.0s of added rest across 6 trials). A pre→post difference is NOT evidence that the interventions caused it: the regime changed too. Compare like with like before claiming a perturbation effect on the Gaussian rail.
